title: Commander Collection: Green: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: From the Roil emerged a ravenous primordial being of pure mana.
Urza's forces tore across Argoth, and Argoth responded in kind.
"The land echoes our intentions, and the kami echo the land. We must strive to live in harmony with the world even when it seems to rise against us." —Diary of Azusa
"A single chord brings them to heel. A whole song, and they dance." —Yisan, the wanderer bard
Deep within the heart of the forest, a new sun flared to life.
"Absolute power is the only true authority. Anything less is a lie told by the weak." —Garruk Wildspeaker
